Welcome

In this study, you will choose pictures to appear on stamps. Your goal is to build a portfolio of the most valuable stamps.

You will first rate pictures, then make choices, learn the values of your chosen stamps, and build your portfolio. Instructions will appear before each phase.

Pre-experimental Phase: Picture Ratings

You will see pictures one at a time. Rate how much you personally like each picture.

Move the slider from Strongly dislike to Strongly like, then select Continue. No information about stamp values will be provided during this phase.

Deliberation Phase — Practice Round 1

You will see the same four picture pairs across two practice rounds and one Decision Round. Choose the picture you think will appear on the more valuable stamp.

Press J for the left picture or K for the right picture. A green border will show your selection.

During practice, respond within 5 seconds. If you miss a response, you will see a warning and move to the next trial. The task will end if you miss three responses across the two practice rounds.
You did not respond. Please make your next practice choice within 5 seconds.

Deliberation Phase — Practice Round 2

Choose between the pictures again, then explain why you made each choice.

Your practice choices will not be submitted to the Board of Evaluation, but your explanations may influence its judgment of the stamps’ values. Please consider your reasons carefully.

Choose within 5 seconds. Take the time you need to type your explanation.

Deliberation Phase — Decision Round

Now make your final choice for each pair. These choices determine which pictures will be submitted to the Board of Evaluation.

Press J for the left picture or K for the right picture. There is no time limit for this round.

Choice Outcome Phase

The Board of Evaluation has evaluated the pictures you selected in the Decision Round of the Deliberation Phase.

You will now see whether each chosen stamp has a Reward or No reward. Pay close attention to these outcomes for the next phase.

Final Decision Phase: Build Your Portfolio

You will now choose between a different set of pictures. Use what you learned in the Choice Outcome Phase to choose the picture you think will appear on the more valuable stamp.

For each picture pair, press J for left or K for right within 7 seconds.

Occasionally, a letter will appear. When it does, press the matching letter on your keyboard.

Memory Test

Congratulations on completing your stamp portfolio! You will now complete a bonus memory test.

For each picture, decide whether you chose it in the Decision Round of the Deliberation Phase.

Press 1 for Yes or 0 for No.

If a pairing question appears, select the picture that was shown alongside it during the Deliberation Phase. Press 1, 2, 3, or 4 to select your answer.

Debrief

This study asks how the outcomes of earlier choices guide later decisions about new pictures, including pictures related to options you did not choose. For example, learning that a stamp you chose was not valuable might lead you to think the alternative would have been better. We want to understand whether that judgment also extends to other pictures in the same category.

The memory test helps us explore how remembering earlier choices and picture pairings relates to these later decisions.

The stamp values were assigned for the experiment: two of your four chosen pictures were randomly assigned a reward, and two were assigned no reward. There was no Board of Evaluation, and your written explanations did not determine these outcomes. This cover story was used to encourage careful consideration of your choices.

For questions, contact yifangsl@stanford.edu. Select Finish to save your responses.
